name: Tsuma no Ichiban Kirei na Sugata
source:
The protagonist, Akifusa, and his beautiful wife, Shibano, lived in a certain village.
The couple loved each other deeply, but for many years, they were unable to conceive.
The cause was Akifusa's “seed.”
Their days living together were happy, yet they also carried the loneliness of “withered hope.”
One day, this couple took in Genta, an apprentice craftsman from another village, as a lodger.
He was polite and handled chores around the house on his days off.
Life with this simple-minded young man brought a fresh breeze to their quiet home.
And then, the faint, yearning glances he began directing at Shibano—glances born of his young, robust physique—
awakened within Akifusa a craving to see his wife desired and lost to another man.
translation:
主人公秋房和他美丽的妻子柴野住在某个村庄里。
夫妻俩深爱着对方，但多年来一直无法怀孕。
原因是秋房的“种子”。
他们一起生活的日子很幸福，但也带着“希望枯萎”的孤独。
有一天，这对夫妇收留了另一个村庄的学徒工匠根太作为房客。
他很有礼貌，休息日会处理家里的杂务。
和这个头脑简单的年轻人一起生活，给他们安静的家带来了一股清新的微风。
然后，他开始向芝野投去淡淡而渴望的目光——年轻而强健的体格所产生的目光——
秋房心中唤醒了一种渴望，想要看到自己的妻子被另一个男人所渴望，却又失去了。
